_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Diagnostic panels that test live data streaming (timer / WebSocket / poll) inside this client.

description:
Diagnostic: test whether LIVE data streaming works in this client.

    Renders a widget with three panels: a JS timer (baseline), the WebSocket
    panel (not offered: the feed needs a credential and none is sent to a
    widget), and an HTTP poll of /quote, each showing a live value + status, so
    you can see which streaming mechanisms the client's widget sandbox permits.
    Use when a live/ticking chart isn't moving.

    Args:
      symbol: G7 pair to stream (default EURUSD).
name: stream_test
title: Live Streaming Diagnostic
